name: pl-dicom_pixel_redact
title: A ChRIS plugin to detect and redact PHI embedded in DICOM pixel data
description: A ChRIS plugin to detect and redact PHI embedded in DICOM pixel data using Microsoft Presidio

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.help: glob pattern (relative to inputdir) used to find DICOM files

parameters.name: fill
parameters.help: redaction box fill strategy: 'contrast' picks black/white for max contrast against the surrounding pixels, 'background' samples the image's background color [choices: contrast, background]

parameters.name: padding_width
parameters.help: pixels of padding added around detected text before OCR, which improves detection but also grows the redacted box

parameters.name: ocr_threshold
parameters.help: minimum OCR confidence (0-100) for a text region to be considered

parameters.name: ocr_psm
parameters.help: Tesseract page segmentation mode. 11: sparse text, find as much text as possible in no particular order (recommended for burned-in annotations scattered across an image); 12: sparse text with orientation detection; 13: raw line, treat the whole image as one text line. Modes are restricted to 11-13 for this workflow; this is not a guarantee of complete PHI detection. [choices: 11, 12, 13]

parameters.name: save_bboxes
parameters.help: write a JSON file of redacted bounding boxes next to each output DICOM

parameters.name: propagate_bboxes
parameters.help: Treat each input subdirectory as one aligned 2D frame sequence; propagate the union of detected redaction regions across every frame. Compressed input allowed; outputs are uncompressed. No detected boxes fails.

parameters.name: propagate_match_tags
parameters.help: implies --propagate-bboxes. Comma-separated DICOM keywords (e.g. PatientID,PatientName,PatientBirthDate,StudyDate,AccessionNumber,InstitutionName). Only detected text matching these header values is propagated to the other frames; other detections stay redacted on their own frame only. Without this option every detection is propagated

parameters.name: copy_others
parameters.help: copy files that did not match --pattern from inputdir to outputdir unchanged. Files that look like DICOM (preamble check) are never copied, because they would be passed through un-redacted; they are reported as failures instead

parameters.name: metadata_recall
parameters.help: by default, header values (PatientName, PatientID, ...) are used to improve detection: (1) a per-file deny-list recognizer built from --recall-tags, and (2) Presidio's own header-derived deny-list. Pass this flag to turn BOTH off and rely only on Presidio's general NER model, e.g. if the header can't be trusted yet.

parameters.name: recall_tags
parameters.help: comma-separated DICOM keywords to pull --metadata-recall values from

parameters.name: recall_min_len
parameters.help: minimum token length (characters) for a --metadata-recall value to be used, to avoid noisy single-character deny-list entries (e.g. a middle-initial fragment of PatientName)
